oneshot_run() {
    # *-install-complete.service: enable daemon, remove temp units
    local f svc base
    f="$(unit_file "$1")"
    svc="$(sed -n 's/.*systemctl enable --now \([^ ]*\).*/\1/p' "$f")"
    f="$(unit_file "$svc")"
    base="$(daemon_base "$svc")"
    state_set "daemon-$base" enabled
    start_daemon "$svc" || return 1
    path_deactivate "${base}-install-complete.path"
    rm -f "/etc/systemd/system/${base}-install-complete.path" "/etc/systemd/system/${base}-install-complete.service"
    return 0
}
